title: Learning Energy-Efficient Air--Ground Actuation for Hybrid Robots on Stair-Like Terrain
abstract: arXiv:2603.26687v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hybrid aerial--ground robots can use thrust to cross obstacles that impede wheel-driven motion, but deciding how much thrust to apply during contact remains challenging. We present an energy-aware reinforcement learning framework that jointly commands wheels, tilt servos and propellers through a single continuous policy, without prescribing locomotion modes. Hardware-calibrated power models penalise estimated electrical energy, while a terrain curriculum and a terminal reward for upright, settled arrivals support learning of thrust-assisted climbing. In simulation, continuous thrust allocation improves single-step clearance over fixed-thrust and mode-switching baselines as steps become taller.   At the wheel-radius step height, it draws approximately 27 percent less mean power than the best fixed allocation. translated_title: 面向混合空-地机器人在类楼梯地形上的节能空地协同执行学习
translated_abstract: 混合空-地机器人可以利用推力跨越阻碍轮式运动的障碍物，但在接触过程中决定施加多少推力仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种能量感知的强化学习框架，通过单一连续策略联合控制车轮、倾斜舵机和螺旋桨，而无需预先指定运动模式。基于硬件标定的功率模型对估计的电能消耗进行惩罚，同时地形课程学习以及对直立、稳定到达的终端奖励支持了推力辅助爬升的学习。在仿真中，随着台阶高度增加，连续推力分配在单步越障能力上优于固定推力和模式切换基线。在等于车轮半径的台阶高度下，其平均功耗比最佳固定推力分配低约27%。能量权重消融实验揭示了效率与可靠性之间的权衡。在物理DoubleBee原型机上……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种能量感知的强化学习框架，通过单一连续策略联合控制混合空-地机器人的车轮、倾斜舵机和螺旋桨，实现节能的推力辅助爬楼，在车轮半径高度的台阶上比最佳固定推力分配节省约27%的平均功耗。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an energy-aware reinforcement learning framework that jointly commands wheels, tilt servos, and propellers via a single continuous policy for energy-efficient thrust-assisted stair climbing, reducing mean power by approximately 27% compared to the best fixed thrust allocation at wheel-radius step height.
